## Methods

### `QueueNotification`

Send a new notification

- Call: `client.Silver.Alerts.QueueNotification(ctx, opts, &out)`
- HTTP route: `POST /api/v1.0/alerts/new`
- Inventory entry: `alerts.queue_notification`
- Observed in: `migrated_from_golden_stoplight`

#### Allows creation / sending of notifications within Incident IQ.  Notifications can be directed at users with varying severity.  Content may include rich HTML and links to other resources.
#### Sample request:
```
POST /api/v1.0/alerts/new
{
  "AlertKey": "Custom-Notification-1",
  "EntityTypeId": "ac6cece8-e4f4-e511-a789-005056bb000e",
  "EntityId": "ac6cece8-e4f4-e511-a789-005056bb000e",
  "Severity": 20,
  "Subject": "Test notification 1",
  "Details": "New notification content - click &lt;a href="#"&gt;here&lt;/a&gt;"
}
```

Migrated from the previous Golden SDK. The published Golden OpenAPI contract no longer documents this route, so it moved to the Silver surface to preserve access. Previously `client.Alerts.QueueNotification` (operationId `Alerts_QueueNotification`).

#### Request Options

| API Name | In | Required | Go Type | RequestOptions Field | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `notification` | `body` | `yes` | `any` | `JSON` | Notification details / parameters |

#### Response

- Decoded with `encoding/json` into the `out` argument when `out` is non-nil.
- The contract declares no JSON response schema for this operation. Decode into `map[string]any` or `[]any` unless you know the shape.
- Documented status codes: `200`. Non-2xx responses return `*incidentiq.APIError`.
